settings.label: Display mode
settings.why: Exclusive fullscreen gives the game the screen to itself, for the lowest input lag.

settings.label: Preferred display mode
settings.why: Keeps the game in exclusive fullscreen when it restarts.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.why: Your monitor's native resolution, so players stay sharp.

settings.label: Refresh rate
settings.why: Your monitor's full refresh rate, so you see every frame it can show.

settings.label: Renderer worker threads
settings.why: One less than your performance cores, so the game's main thread keeps a core to itself. Capped at 7, which tested best on CPUs with more than 8 cores. Not in the game's menu.

settings.label: Keep these settings
settings.why: Stops the game resetting your graphics to its recommended preset on the next launch. Not in the game's menu.

settings.label: Quality preset
settings.why: Matches the preset these settings were tested under, so the game keeps the custom values below.

settings.label: V-Sync (gameplay)
settings.why: V-Sync holds frames back to match the screen, which adds input lag.

settings.label: V-Sync (menus)
settings.why: Keeps menus as responsive as the game.

settings.label: Render resolution
settings.why: Renders at your full resolution, so enemies stay sharp.

settings.label: Dynamic resolution
settings.why: Stops the game blurring the picture when frames dip.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.why: SMAA smooths edges with almost no cost and no upscaling blur.

settings.label: Texture resolution
settings.why: Low textures free up video memory and cut stutter. Players read the same either way.

settings.label: Texture filter anisotropic
settings.why: Lowest filtering for the most frames.

settings.label: Detail quality level
settings.why: Lower model detail for more frames.

settings.label: Particle resolution
settings.why: Smoke and explosions cost less and block less of your view.

settings.label: Shader quality
settings.why: Lower shader cost for more frames.

settings.label: Shading quality
settings.why: Lower shading cost for more frames.

settings.label: Shadow quality
settings.why: Shadows are one of the most expensive settings.

settings.label: Shadow filtering
settings.why: Cheaper shadow edges for more frames.

settings.label: Screen space shadows
settings.why: Turns off extra contact shadows for more frames.

settings.label: Screen space reflections
settings.why: Reflections cost frames and add visual noise.

settings.label: Screen space reflections (variant)
settings.why: The same reflections setting, kept in step.

settings.label: Ambient lighting
settings.why: Turns off costly indirect lighting for more frames.

settings.label: Terrain quality
settings.why: Lower ground detail for more frames.

settings.label: Tessellation
settings.why: Tessellation adds geometry you won't notice in a fight.

settings.label: Volumetric quality
settings.why: Lower fog and light shafts for more frames and clearer sight lines.

settings.label: Volumetric quality (variant)
settings.why: The same volumetric setting, kept in step.

settings.label: Water caustics
settings.why: Turns off light patterns under water.

settings.label: Water wave wetness
settings.why: Turns off wet surfaces from waves.

settings.label: Weather grid volumes
settings.why: Turns off weather volumes for more frames.

settings.label: On-demand texture streaming
settings.why: Streams less data while you play, for fewer hitches.

settings.label: Deferred physics quality
settings.why: Cheaper physics effects for more frames.

settings.label: Persistent damage
settings.why: Turns off lasting damage decals.

settings.label: Bullet impacts
settings.why: Fewer impact effects for more frames and less clutter.

settings.label: Ray tracing
settings.why: Ray tracing costs a lot of frames.

settings.label: Ray tracing quality
settings.why: Keeps ray tracing fully off.

settings.label: Variable rate shading
settings.why: Shades less detail where you won't notice it, for more frames.

settings.label: Half-resolution reflections
settings.why: Cheaper reflections for more frames. Not in the game's menu.

settings.label: Depth of field
settings.why: Keeps the whole screen in focus.

settings.label: Weapon depth of field off
settings.why: Stops your weapon going blurry.

settings.label: World depth of field off
settings.why: Stops the background going blurry when you aim.

settings.label: World motion blur
settings.why: Motion blur smears the screen when you turn.

settings.label: Weapon motion blur
settings.why: Stops your weapon smearing when you move.
